title: 第一卷 第28章 八极，吴正明
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
津门，漕运商会。

    沈玉楼捂着半拉耳朵，疼得直抽冷气。

    纱布缠了一圈又一圈，但还是渗血。

    他坐在太师椅上，脸比锅底还黑。

    对面坐着两个人。

    大会长冯天涯，二会长杨成安。

    “欺人太甚！”

    杨成安猛地一拍桌子，茶杯震得老高。

    “一个二十岁的毛头小子，骑在咱们头上拉屎！这要是传出去，津门还有咱们漕运商会的立足之地吗？”

    冯天涯没说话，只是阴沉着脸，手指敲着桌面。

    “笃，笃，笃......”

    每一下，都像是敲在人心里。

    “洋人的枪，打在了咱们的脸上。”

    冯天涯终于开口，声音冷得像冰，“陆川这是在立威。”

    “大哥，那怎么办？真就这么忍了？”

    杨成安急了，“要不我带人去把他那百乐门给平了！”

    “平个屁！”

    沈玉楼嘶哑着嗓子骂道，“你没看见史密斯那个疯狗样？连自己人都敢崩，你带人去送死啊？”

    杨成安被噎住了。

    是啊，史密斯现在跟陆川穿一条裤子。

    硬碰硬，讨不到好。

    “那就这么算了？”

    “当然不能算。”

    冯天涯停下敲击的手指，抬眼看向沈玉楼，“老沈，你在道上混了三十年，有没有什么路子？”

    沈玉楼眼中闪过一丝狠色。

    “有！”

    “北平城里有个叫吴正明的，八极拳传人，明劲巅峰的高手。”

    “当年他在擂台上，三招打死过一头牛。”

    “只要请他出手，陆川必死无疑。”

    “代价呢？”

    “五万大洋。”

    “成交。”

    冯天涯连眼皮都没眨一下，“钱不是问题，我要的是他的人头。”

    两日后，深夜。

    陆川的小洋楼里，一片漆黑。

    二楼卧室。

    陆小鱼抱着枕头睡得正香，小嘴微张像是在做什么美梦。

    陆川在隔壁房间盘膝而坐，缓缓修炼养气决。

    突然！

    他睁开了眼。

    没有风声，没有脚步声。

    但空气中多了一丝极淡的汽油味。

    “啪啦——”

    一楼客厅的玻璃窗被人砸碎。

    紧接着，几个燃烧的火把飞了进来。

    火苗舔舐着地毯，迅速蔓延。

    “哥......怎么了？”

    隔壁房间的陆小鱼揉着眼睛醒来，一脸茫然。

    “没事，老鼠咬坏了窗帘。”

    陆川已经推门走了进来，一把抱起小鱼，顺手扯过被子把她裹住。

    “抱紧哥哥。”

    话音未落。

    陆川抱着小鱼，直接从二楼窗户跳了出去。

    落地无声。

    楼下院子里，站着五个黑衣人。

    他们手里提着煤油桶，正准备往屋里泼。

    看到陆川从天而降，五人吓了一跳。

    “点子扎手！撤！”

    为首那人反应极快，转身就跑。

    “跑？”

    陆川放下小鱼，让她靠在墙角。

    “小鱼乖，闭上眼睛数到十。”

    “哦......”

    陆小鱼虽然害怕，但还是乖乖闭上了眼。

    “一，二，三......”

    就在她数数的瞬间。

    陆川动了。

    他弯腰，从花坛边捡起一块青砖。

    手腕一抖。

    青砖化作一道残影，撕裂空气。

    “砰！”

    跑在最前面的那人，后脑勺直接炸开，红的白的溅了一地。

    像个烂西瓜。
content_en:
Jinmen, Water Transport Chamber of Commerce.

    Shen Yulou covered his ears and gasped in pain.

    The gauze was wrapped around and around, but blood still oozed.

    He was sitting on the Taishi chair, his face darker than the bottom of the pot.

    Two people were sitting opposite.

    The president of the conference is Feng Tianya, and the second president is Yang Chengan.

    "It's too much!"

    Yang Chengan slammed the table, causing the tea cup to shake.

    "A twenty-year-old boy is shitting on our heads! If word of this spreads, will our Water Transport Chamber of Commerce still have a foothold in Tianjin?"

    Feng Tianya didn't speak, he just had a gloomy face and tapped his fingers on the table.

    "Tuk, Tuk, Tuk..."

    Every blow seems to hit people's hearts.

    "The foreigners' guns hit us in the face."

    Feng Tianya finally spoke, his voice as cold as ice, "Lu Chuan is trying to establish his authority."

    "Brother, what should I do? Are you really going to endure it like this?"

    Yang Chengan was anxious, "How about I take people to level his Paramount!"

    "Fuck you!"

    Shen Yulou cursed in a hoarse voice, "Have you not seen what a mad dog Smith looks like? He dares to kill his own people, so you lead them to die?"

    Yang Chengan was choked.

    Yes, Smith and Lu Chuan are wearing the same pants now.

    You won't get any favors if you fight head-on.

    "Then let's forget it?"

    "Of course it doesn't count."

    Feng Tianya stopped tapping his fingers and raised his eyes to look at Shen Yulou, "Old Shen, you have been on the road for thirty years, is there any way out?"

    A trace of cruelty flashed in Shen Yulou's eyes.

    "Yes!"

    "There is a man named Wu Zhengming in Beiping City. He is the successor of Bajiquan and a master of peak Mingjin."

    "Back then, he killed a cow in three moves in the ring."

    "As long as he is asked to take action, Lu Chuan will definitely die."

    "What's the price?"

    "Fifty thousand oceans."

    "Deal."

    Feng Tianya didn't even blink, "Money is not an issue, what I want is his head."

    Two days later, late at night.

    It was pitch dark in Lu Chuan's small foreign-style building.

    Second floor bedroom.

    Lu Xiaoyu was sleeping soundly with his pillow in his arms, his mouth slightly open as if he was having a sweet dream.

    Lu Chuan sat cross-legged in the next room, slowly practicing the Qi Nourishing Technique.

    Sudden!

    He opened his eyes.

    There was no sound of wind, no sound of footsteps.

    But there was a very faint smell of gasoline in the air.

    "Crack-"

    The glass window in the living room on the first floor was smashed.

    Immediately afterwards, several burning torches flew in.

    The flames licked the carpet and spread quickly.

    "Brother...what's wrong?"

    Lu Xiaoyu in the next room woke up rubbing his eyes with a confused look on his face.

    "It's okay, the mouse bit the curtain."

    Lu Chuan had already opened the door and walked in. He picked up Xiaoyu and pulled the quilt to wrap her up.

    "Hold brother tight."

    The words have not yet finished.

    Lu Chuan hugged Xiaoyu and jumped out from the second floor window.

    It landed silently.

    In the courtyard downstairs, there were five men in black standing.

    They were carrying kerosene barrels and were about to pour it into the house.

    The five of them were shocked when they saw Lu Chuan falling from the sky.

    "The idea is thorny! Withdraw!"

    The leader reacted very quickly, turned around and ran away.

    "Run?"

    Lu Chuan put Xiaoyu down and let her lean against the corner.

    "Be good, little fish, close your eyes and count to ten."

    "Oh..."

    Although Lu Xiaoyu was scared, he still closed his eyes obediently.

    "One, two, three..."

    Just as she was counting.

    Lu Chuan moved.

    He bent down and picked up a green brick from the flower bed.

    A flick of the wrist.

    The green brick turned into an afterimage, tearing the air apart.

    "Bang!"

    The man running at the front had his head exploded, with red and white splattering all over the floor.

    Like a rotten watermelon.
